purpose: Remi Home is the launcher and entry point for the whole app, a standalone page separate from the app shell. It greets the user by time of day and shows two large clickable preview cards: "01 Control Panel", which opens Remi.dc.html (the command center with Today, Timeline, Projects, Routines and the move), and "02 Textbook", which opens Remi Textbook.dc.html (numbered notes, formulas and live charts). Each card holds a small animated illustration of its destination. The Control Panel card shows a capacity strip and a mini Gantt; the Textbook card shows a typeset primer excerpt with a typewriter effect and a slash menu on hover. Clicking a card, or pressing 1 or 2, runs a transition where a blank paper card expands to fill the screen, then the browser navigates to the destination page. The page reads the two localStorage stores ('remi.v1' and 'remi.textbook.v1') only to fill small count labels.
layout:
STAGE AND SCALING
- Outer wrapper: `position:fixed; inset:0; overflow:hidden; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ink) 6%, var(--paper))`. This is the letterbox colour.
- Stage `[data-screen-label="Remi home"]` is always designed at a fixed 1920x1080: `position:absolute; left:{st.x}px; top:{st.y}px; width:1920px; height:1080px; transform:scale(st.s); transform-origin:0 0; background:var(--paper); overflow:hidden`.
- Scale: `sc = min(vw/1920, vh/1080)`. The stage is centred with `x = round((vw - 1920*sc)/2)` and `y = round((vh - 1080*sc)/2)`.
- At a 1920x1080 viewport, sc = 1 with no letterbox. At 2560x1440, sc = 1.3333 with x = y = 0, so the whole page scales up uniformly. Any other aspect ratio gets letterbox bars on two sides. The layout does not reflow; it only scales.
- All coordinates below are in 1920x1080 stage pixels.

1) TOP HEADER BAR
- `position:absolute; left:120px; right:120px; top:0; height:88px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:28px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--hairline)`.
- Fades in: `opacity {a0.o}; transition: opacity 200ms var(--ease-out)`.
- Children, left to right:
  - (a) Wordmark "Remi": font-display (Libre Caslon Text), 26px, letter-spacing -0.01em.
  - (b) A `flex:1` spacer.
  - (c) Date cluster: `display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:10px`. Contains "Mon 5 Oct" (16px, weight 600), "·" (colour ink-faint) and "BD3" (font-numeric JetBrains Mono, 13px, ink-muted).
  - (d) Vertical divider, 1px x 20px, background hairline.
  - (e) Countdown: `display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:8px`. Contains "61" (16px, 600) and "business days to Fixed Income" (15px, ink-muted).

2) HERO
- Block: `position:absolute; left:120px; top:176px; width:1100px`.
- Greeting line: 12px, weight 600, letter-spacing 0.1em, uppercase, ink-muted. Text is e.g. "GOOD EVENING · MONDAY 5 OCTOBER".
- H1: `margin:18px 0 0`, font-display, weight 400, 92px, line-height 1.02, letter-spacing -0.025em. Text is "Where to this morning|afternoon|evening?".

3) CARD GRID
- `position:absolute; left:120px; right:120px; top:388px; display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; column-gap:48px`.
- Content width is 1680px, so each column is (1680-48)/2 = 816px.
- Control Panel card rect: x = 120, y = 388, 816 x 560.
- Textbook card rect: x = 984, y = 388, 816 x 560. Bottom edge of both cards is y = 948.

Card shell (both cards identical):
- `position:relative; height:560px; box-sizing:border-box; padding:34px 40px 30px; border-radius:var(--radius-m)=6px; background:var(--paper-raised); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px {line}; cursor:pointer; display:flex; flex-direction:column; overflow:hidden`.
- Inner content width is 816 - 80 = 736px.

Card header row:
- `display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:16px`.
- Index "01" or "02": mono, 13px, ink-muted.
- Title "Control Panel" or "Textbook": font-display, 44px, line-height 1, letter-spacing -0.015em.
- A flex:1 spacer.
- Round button: `display:grid; place-items:center; width:40px; height:40px; border-radius:50%; background:{btnBg}; color:{btnFg}; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px {btnLine}`. It holds the Material Symbols Outlined glyph "arrow_forward" at 20px, shifted by `transform: translateX({arrowX})`.

Card description:
- 16px, ink-muted, margin-top 14px.

Preview area:
- `position:relative; flex:1; margin-top:26px; border-top:1px solid var(--hairline)`. The Textbook card adds `padding-top:22px`.
- Height is roughly 390px (the card's 496px inner height minus the header, description and margins).

Card footer strip (inside the preview area):
- `position:absolute; left:0; right:0; bottom:0; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; padding-top:14px; border-top:1px solid var(--hairline)`.

3a) CONTROL PANEL PREVIEW (all positions are relative to the preview area, which is 736px wide)
- Capacity strip: `position:absolute; left:0; right:0; top:14px; height:44px; display:flex; align-items:flex-end; gap:3px`.
  - 30 bars, each `flex:1`, about 21.63px wide ((736 - 29*3)/30).
  - Bar height = `h/10*100%` of 44px. So 8h = 80% = 35.2px, 9.5h = 95% = 41.8px, 3h = 30% = 13.2px.
  - Bar style: `border-radius:1px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px {line}; background:{bg}`.
- Dashed separator: `position:absolute; left:0; right:0; top:66px; border-top:1px dashed var(--hairline)`.
- Gantt rows: 5 rows, each `position:absolute; left:0; right:0; top:(86 + i*34)px; height:12px`, so rows sit at top 86, 120, 154, 188 and 222px. Each row contains:
  - (i) Ghost/target outline: `position:absolute; left:{gx}; width:{gw}; top:14px; height:6px; box-sizing:border-box; border:1.5px dashed {accent}; border-radius:2px; opacity:{go}`.
  - (ii) Main bar: `left:{x}; width:{w}; top:0; height:10px; border-radius:2px; background:{bg}; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px {line}`.
  - (iii) Overrun segment: `left:{ox}; width:{ow}; top:0; height:10px; border-radius:0 2px 2px 0; background:var(--risk)`.
  - (iv) Milestone diamonds: one per ms entry, `position:absolute; left:{pct}; top:0; width:10px; height:10px; margin-left:-5px; box-sizing:border-box; transform: rotate(45deg) scale({ds}); background:var(--paper-raised); border:1.5px solid {accent}`.
- Today line: `position:absolute; top:6px; bottom:44px; left:4%; width:1px; background:var(--ink)`.
- Move line: `top:6px; bottom:44px; left:84%; width:1.5px; background:var(--fi-accent)`.
- Footer strip, left to right:
  - "Returns pipeline": 14px, weight 500.
  - Forecast date: 15px, weight 500, display:flex, rendered by `<dc-import name="Roll" value={cp.fS}>`, hint size 90x20.
  - Delta pill: `display:inline-flex; align-items:center; height:22px; padding:0 7px; border-radius:3px; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--risk) 22%, var(--paper)); color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--risk) 40%, var(--ink)); font-family: mono; font-size:11px; font-weight:600`. It contains a Roll of {cp.delta}, hint size 44x14.
  - A flex:1 spacer.
  - Meta: 13px, ink-muted, e.g. "5 projects · 2 routines · 3 notes today".

3b) TEXTBOOK PREVIEW
- Breadcrumb: `display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:10px; font-size:11px; color:ink-muted`. Contains "Fixed Income" (weight 600, letter-spacing 0.08em, uppercase), then "/", then "Rates primer".
- Row "1": `display:grid; grid-template-columns:44px minmax(0,1fr); margin-top:16px; align-items:baseline`. Number "1" is mono 14px ink-muted. "Rates and duration" is font-display 26px, letter-spacing -0.01em.
- Row "1.1": same grid, margin-top 12px. "1.1" is mono 13px ink-muted. "Price and yield" is 16px, weight 600.
- Paragraph: `margin:8px 0 0 44px; font-size:15px; line-height:1.55; ink-muted`. Text: "When yields rise, bond prices fall. For small moves:".
- Formula: `margin:12px 0 0 44px; font-display; font-style:italic; font-size:22px; letter-spacing:0.01em`. Text: "ΔP / P ≈ −D × Δy" (uses the real U+0394, U+2248, U+2212 and U+00D7 characters).
- Where-line: `margin:10px 0 0 44px; font-size:14px; line-height:1.5; ink-muted`. The symbols D and Δy are set in font-display italic in colour var(--ink).
- Row "1.2": `position:relative; display:grid; grid-template-columns:44px minmax(0,1fr); margin-top:18px; align-items:baseline`.
  - "1.2" is mono 13px ink-muted with opacity {nextO}.
  - Typed word "Convexity": 16px, 600, `white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; display:inline-block; max-width:{typeW}`.
  - Caret: `display:inline-block; width:1.5px; height:18px; margin-left:2px; background:var(--ink); transform:translateY(3px); opacity:{caretO}`.
  - Slash menu, absolutely positioned: `left:150px; top:-6px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:4px; padding:5px; border-radius:6px; background:var(--paper); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--hairline), 0 14px 28px -20px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ink) 45%, transparent)`.
    - It starts with a "/" glyph: mono 12px, ink-muted, padding 0 6px.
    - Then 4 chips, each `height:26px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; padding:0 9px; border-radius:3px; font-size:12px; font-weight:500; background:{bg}`.
- Footer strip: "Numbered sections · formulas · live charts" (13px ink-muted), a flex:1 spacer, then {tbPages} (13px ink-muted), e.g. "4 pages · 1 live chart".

4) PAGE FOOTER
- `position:absolute; left:120px; right:120px; bottom:40px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:24px; font-size:13px; color:ink-muted`.
- Opacity {a0.o} with `transition: opacity 200ms var(--ease-out) 240ms`.
- Left: "Press [1] or [2] to jump straight in". Each key chip is `font-family:mono; font-size:12px; padding:1px 6px; border:1px solid var(--hairline); border-radius:3px; color:var(--ink)`.
- A flex:1 spacer.
- Right: "A personal instrument. Nothing here is shared."

5) EXPAND OVERLAY
- A single div, last child of the stage: `position:absolute; left:{ex.x}px; top:{ex.y}px; width:{ex.w}px; height:{ex.h}px; border-radius:{ex.r}; background:var(--paper); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--hairline); opacity:{ex.o}; pointer-events:none; z-index:20; transition:{ex.tr}`.
- At rest it is 0x0 at (0,0) with opacity 0.

components.name: HomeStage (root)
components.description: Fixed-size 1920x1080 stage that scales to fit the viewport and is letterboxed and centred. The letterbox colour is color-mix(in oklch, var(--ink) 6%, var(--paper)). It re-measures on window resize. It hosts the header, hero, the two cards, the footer and the expand overlay. It carries data-screen-label="Remi home" and sets the document title "Remi".
states: pre-arrival (arrived=false): everything at opacity 0 and translated down
arrived (true after a double rAF)
expanding (ex set): further clicks and keys are ignored

components.name: HomeHeader
components.description: 88px-tall bar at the top of the stage, 120px side insets, with a hairline bottom border. Left: the "Remi" wordmark in Libre Caslon, 26px. Right: "Mon 5 Oct" (16px/600), "·", "BD3" (mono 13px, muted), a 1x20 divider, then "61" (16px/600) and "business days to Fixed Income" (15px, muted). All values are hard-coded. It fades in over 200ms ease-out.
states: hidden (opacity 0)
shown

components.name: Hero (greeting + headline)
components.description: Placed at left 120, top 176, width 1100. The greeting is small caps: 12px, weight 600, tracking 0.1em, uppercase, muted, reading "Good morning|afternoon|evening · Monday 5 October". The H1 is Libre Caslon 400 at 92px, line-height 1.02, tracking -0.025em, reading "Where to this morning|afternoon|evening?". The time-of-day word comes from the real clock: hour < 12 is morning, < 18 is afternoon, otherwise evening. The date text is hard-coded.
states: pre-arrival: opacity 0, translateY(10px)
arrived: opacity 1, transform none

components.name: LauncherCard (shared shell)
components.description: 816x560 card with padding 34/40/30, radius 6, paper-raised background and a 1px inset hairline (box-shadow) border. It uses cursor:pointer and overflow:hidden. Header row: mono index number, Libre Caslon 44px title, and a 40px round arrow button (Material Symbols arrow_forward at 20px). Below that, a 16px muted description, then a preview area with a top hairline, then a footer strip with a top hairline. The whole card is a clickable div with onMouseEnter, onMouseLeave and onClick handlers. It is not a button or link and has no tabindex.
states: pre-arrival: opacity 0, translateY(14px) (none if reduced motion)
rest: inset border hairline, button transparent with an ink arrow and hairline ring, transform none
hover: inset border becomes var(--ink), card lifts translateY(-4px) (not under reduced motion), button fills var(--ink) with a var(--paper) arrow and ink ring, arrow shifts translateX(2px)
expanding: an overlay covers it

components.name: ControlPanelCard (01)
components.description:
Title "Control Panel". Description: "Today, the timeline, projects, routines and the move, recalculated as you go." The preview is a decorative mini command center, made of the following pieces.

(1) A 30-bar capacity strip, 44px high, from the CAP array. On hover it switches to the CAPH array, where days 16-18 (0-based) jump from 7/6/5.5h to 9h. Any value over 8 renders red (overload). Bars 25-29 render blue (FI, after the move line). The rest render green (PC).

(2) A dashed hairline at 66px.

(3) Five Gantt rows at y = 86/120/154/188/222. Rows 0-2 are PC green and rows 3-4 are FI blue.
- Row 4 is hatched: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, fi-accent-soft 0 4px, transparent 4px 8px) with a 1px fi-accent inset border. Elsewhere in the design system this hatch means "No plan yet" or a project in its Define phase.
- Row 0 is the Returns pipeline. It has a solid bar up to its target at 57.5%, an amber var(--risk) overrun segment from 57.5% to 62% (to 65.5% on hover), and a dashed ghost outline 6px high at top 14px. The ghost is at opacity 0.4 and ends at the target (57.5%) at rest. On hover it is at opacity 0.9 and ends at 62%, the previous forecast.
- Rows carry 10px diamond milestones: white fill with a 1.5px accent border, rotated 45deg.

(4) A today line at left 4% (1px ink) and an FI move line at left 84% (1.5px fi-accent). Both run from top 6px to bottom 44px.

(5) Footer: "Returns pipeline", then a rolling forecast date ("Wed 2 Dec", changing to "Fri 4 Dec" on hover), then an amber delta pill ("+3 BD", changing to "+5 BD" on hover), then on the right the meta line "{projects} projects · {routines} routines · {notes} note(s) today".

The hover effect reads as a "what if scope is added" preview: the forecast slips 2 BD, the overrun grows, and three overload days appear in the capacity strip.
states: pre-arrival: cap bars at height 0%, Gantt widths 0, overrun width 0, diamonds scale 0
arrived rest: CAP, forecast Wed 2 Dec, +3 BD
hover (hc): CAPH, row-0 end 0.655, ghost to 0.62 at 0.9 opacity, forecast Fri 4 Dec, +5 BD

components.name: TextbookCard (02)
components.description:
Title "Textbook". Description: "Numbered notes, clean formulas and live charts you drop in from Claude."

The preview is a typeset primer excerpt:
- Breadcrumb "FIXED INCOME / Rates primer".
- "1  Rates and duration" (Caslon, 26px).
- "1.1  Price and yield" (16px/600).
- A muted paragraph, then an italic Caslon formula "ΔP / P ≈ −D × Δy" at 22px.
- A where-line with italic D and Δy.
- Row "1.2" at opacity 0.35 at rest, where "Convexity" is typed out on hover. max-width animates from 0ch to 9ch with steps(9, end) over 520ms, and a 1.5x18px ink caret appears. The caret does not blink.
- A floating slash-menu pill at left 150px, top -6px on the 1.2 row: "/ | Heading | Formula | Callout | Link to project". "Heading" is highlighted with color-mix(in oklch, var(--ink) 6%, transparent). The pill fades and slides in with a 560ms delay, after the typing finishes.

Footer: "Numbered sections · formulas · live charts" on the left and "{N} pages · {M} live chart(s)" on the right.
states: rest: 1.2 at opacity 0.35, typed width 0ch, caret hidden, menu hidden at translateY(-4px)
hover (ht): 1.2 at opacity 1, typed to 9ch, caret visible, menu visible at translateY(0) after a 560ms delay

components.name: Roll (child: Roll.dc.html)
components.description:
Odometer-style text roller used for the forecast date and the delta pill.

It renders an invisible copy of the full text to reserve width. On top of that it absolutely positions one clipped column per token, each 1.25em tall with overflow hidden. Each column is a vertical stack of the token's possible values, translated by translateY(-index*1.25em) with `transition: transform var(--dur-slow)=440ms var(--spring-soft)`.

Parsing rules:
- Date regex: `^(?:(Mon|Tue|Wed|Thu|Fri|Sat|Sun) )?(\d{1,2}) (Jan|...|Dec)$`. This produces a weekday column (WD list), a static space, a tens-digit column (DIG list, where '' means blank), a units-digit column, a static space, and a month column (MON list).
- Number regex: `^([+−-]?)(\d{1,3})(?:\.(\d))?(\D*)$`. This produces a sign column ['', '+', '−'] (a hyphen-minus is converted to U+2212), three digit columns from padStart(3,' ') with blank cells as '', a '.' column, a decimal-digit column, and a static suffix (e.g. ' BD').
- Anything else renders as static text.

On hover, "Wed 2 Dec" becomes "Fri 4 Dec" (the weekday column rolls Wed→Fri and the unit digit rolls 2→4), and "+3 BD" becomes "+5 BD".
states: value-driven; animates whenever the value changes

components.name: ExpandOverlay
components.description: Blank paper card with a 1px inset hairline, at z-index 20 with pointer-events none. When a card is chosen, the overlay appears exactly over that card at radius 6px, fades in, then springs out to fill the whole 1920x1080 stage at radius 0. After that the page navigates away. It acts as a shared-element-style hand-off into the destination page.
states: idle: 0x0, opacity 0, transition none
placed over the card, opacity 0
fading in: opacity 1 over 140ms
expanding to full stage over 420ms spring-soft
navigate at +520ms

components.name: PageFooter
components.description: Placed at bottom 40px, with 120px side insets, 13px muted text. Left: "Press [1] or [2] to jump straight in", with bordered mono key chips. Right: "A personal instrument. Nothing here is shared." It fades in over 200ms ease-out after a 240ms delay.
states: hidden
shown

dataConsumed: localStorage 'remi.v1' (read once in componentDidMount, wrapped in try/catch). Shape as written by Remi.dc.html: { projects: Project[], tasks, feed, funds, routines: Routine[], doneOn, bauDone, notes: { [isoDate: string]: Array<{id, t:'HH:MM', text}> }, m2? }. Home reads three things: s.notes['2026-10-05'].length (the date key is hard-coded), s.projects.length (falls back to 5 if 0 or missing), and s.routines.length (falls back to 2 if 0 or missing).

When 'remi.v1' is absent, state becomes notes = 3, with the state defaults projects = 5 and routines = 2. These match the seed data in Remi.dc.html: BASE_NOTES['2026-10-05'] has 3 notes; BASE_PROJECTS has 5 projects (ret, manco, play = PC; fion, alpha = FI); ROUTINES has 2 (r-ret Returns on BD3 at 6h, r-man ManCo pack on BD8 at 4h).

localStorage 'remi.textbook.v1' (read once in componentDidMount, try/catch). Shape as written by Remi Textbook.dc.html: { cur, sections?: [{id,label,accent}], pages: Array<{ id, section, title, updated, parent?, blocks: Array<{ id, type: 'p'|'h1'|'h2'|'h3'|'bullet'|'callout'|'formula'|'chart'|..., text, html?, src?, name?, h?, cap? }> }> }.

From 'remi.textbook.v1' Home derives pageCount = pages.length and liveCharts = the count of blocks with type === 'chart' && (html || src), summed across all pages. When the key is absent it uses 4 pages and 1 chart, which matches the Textbook SEED (fi-rates, fi-rot, pc-ret, gen-how, with one chart block src 'charts/price-yield.html').
Initial tbPages string before any read: '4 pages · 1 live chart'.
window.innerWidth and innerHeight, for the stage scale.
new Date().getHours(), for the greeting and headline time-of-day word.
window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches, checked in every render and on click.
cpRef and tbRef DOM measurements: offsetLeft, offsetTop, offsetWidth, offsetHeight and offsetParent.offsetLeft/offsetTop. offsetParent is the card grid at (120, 388).

Hard-coded display values that are NOT read from data: 'Mon 5 Oct', 'BD3', '61' business days to Fixed Income, 'Monday 5 October', the returns forecast 'Wed 2 Dec' / 'Fri 4 Dec', the delta '+3 BD' / '+5 BD', the CAP and CAPH arrays, the rowsDef geometry, and all Textbook preview copy. They mirror the Remi.dc.html seed: TODAY = 2026-10-05, MOVE = 2027-01-04, and the 'ret' project with target 2026-11-27 and forecast 2026-12-02; feed item f1 says 'Forecast moved 27 Nov → 2 Dec', '+3 BD'.
interactions:
Hover over the Control Panel card (onMouseEnter) sets hover = 'cp'.
- The card border goes from hairline to ink, and the card lifts translateY(-4px) (skipped under reduced motion).
- The arrow button fills with ink, the arrow turns paper-coloured and nudges 2px right.
- The capacity strip switches from CAP to CAPH, so bars 16, 17 and 18 grow to 9h and turn red.
- Row 0's overrun extends from 62% to 65.5%, and its ghost outline extends to 62% with opacity rising from 0.4 to 0.9.
- The forecast rolls from 'Wed 2 Dec' to 'Fri 4 Dec' and the delta from '+3 BD' to '+5 BD'.

Hover over the Textbook card sets hover = 'tb'.
- The border, lift and arrow button change the same way as on the Control Panel card.
- '1.2' goes from 0.35 to full opacity.
- 'Convexity' types out over 520ms in 9 steps and the caret appears.
- The slash menu (/ Heading Formula Callout Link to project) fades and slides in after a 560ms delay.
onMouseLeave on either card sets hover = null and everything reverts. On leave the slash-menu delay is 0ms, so it disappears at once. The typed text 'untypes' in 9 steps over 520ms.
Click on the Control Panel card, or press '1' anywhere, calls openCP(). This runs the expand transition from the CP card rect, then sets window.location.href = 'Remi.dc.html'.
Click on the Textbook card, or press '2' anywhere, calls openTB(). This runs the expand transition from the TB card rect, then sets window.location.href = 'Remi%20Textbook.dc.html'.

The keyboard handler is a window 'keydown' listener that compares e.key to '1' or '2'. It has no modifier checks, no input-focus guard and no preventDefault. The numpad 1 and 2 keys also produce e.key '1'/'2'. There is no Escape handler and no Enter/Space activation. The cards are not focusable (they are divs with no tabindex or role).
Re-entrancy guard: expand() returns early if state.ex is already set, so double clicks and key mashing are ignored once the transition has started.
Under reduced motion, or if the ref is missing, expand() navigates immediately with no overlay.
Window resize re-computes the stage scale and offsets.

Return path (defined in the other files): Remi.dc.html goHome fades the '[data-screen-label="Remi app"]' root to opacity 0 over 180ms var(--ease-out), then navigates to 'Remi%20Home.dc.html'. Under reduced motion it navigates immediately. Remi Textbook.dc.html goHome fades its stage in the same way over 180ms, then navigates.
motion: ARRIVAL. state.arrived flips from false to true inside requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(...)) after mount, so the initial hidden styles paint first. Every entrance below is a CSS transition keyed off `arrived`.
Header (a0): opacity 0→1, `transition: opacity 200ms var(--ease-out)`, no delay. Its transform is ignored because the header binds only opacity.

Greeting (a1): opacity 0→1 via `opacity 180ms var(--ease-out)`. Transform translateY(10px)→none via `transform 260ms var(--spring-soft)`. No delay. Under reduced motion the transform is always 'none' and only the opacity fades.
H1 (a2): opacity via `opacity 200ms var(--ease-out) 40ms`. Transform translateY(10px)→none via `transform 320ms var(--spring-soft) 40ms`.

Control Panel card (a4 opacity, cp.t transform): opacity via `opacity 220ms var(--ease-out) 120ms`. Transform translateY(14px)→none via `transform 360ms var(--spring-soft)` with NO delay (only the opacity is delayed). The same transition also drives the hover lift to translateY(-4px). The card also has `box-shadow var(--dur-base)=240ms var(--ease-out)` for the border colour change.
Textbook card (a5, tb.t): same as the Control Panel card, but the opacity delay is 170ms: `opacity 220ms var(--ease-out) 170ms, transform 360ms var(--spring-soft), box-shadow 240ms var(--ease-out)`.
Page footer (a0): `opacity 200ms var(--ease-out) 240ms`.

Capacity bars: height 0%→(h*10)% with `transition: height var(--dur-slow)=440ms var(--spring-soft) {i*12}ms, background 240ms var(--ease-out)`. The stagger runs 0,12,24...348ms left to right. The same transition animates the CAP↔CAPH hover change, so bars 16-18 grow from 7/6/5.5 to 9 and their colour crossfades to red. Each hover change replays with the per-bar stagger.
Gantt main bars: width 0→w with `transition: width 440ms var(--spring-soft) {d}`, where d = i*50+80 ms (80, 130, 180, 230, 280ms for rows 0-4).

Overrun segment (row 0 only has a non-zero width): `transition: left 440ms var(--spring-soft) {d}, width 440ms var(--spring-soft) {d}`. Width goes 0→4.5% on arrival and 4.5%↔8.0% on hover, with the row-0 delay of 80ms.
Ghost outline: `transition: opacity 400ms var(--ease-out)`, 0.4↔0.9 on hover. Its width changes 55.5%↔60% on hover with no transition, so it jumps.
Milestone diamonds: `transform: rotate(45deg) scale(0→1)` with `transition: transform var(--dur-base)=240ms var(--ease-out) {d}` (the row delay).

Card arrow button: `transition: background 240ms var(--ease-out), color 240ms var(--ease-out)`. The box-shadow ring colour is NOT in the transition list, so it snaps. The arrow glyph uses `transform: translateX(0→2px)` with `transition: transform 240ms var(--spring-soft)`.
Roll odometer (forecast date and delta): each character column slides `transform: translateY(-i*1.25em)` with `transition: transform 440ms var(--spring-soft)`, no stagger.
Textbook '1.2' number: `opacity 0.35↔1`, `transition: opacity 200ms var(--ease-out)`.

Typewriter: `max-width 0ch↔9ch`, `transition: max-width 520ms steps(9, end)`. That reveals one character roughly every 58ms. Caret: `opacity 0↔1`, `transition: opacity 120ms linear`. The caret does not blink.

Slash menu: opacity 0↔1 and transform translateY(-4px)↔translateY(0). Transition is `opacity 200ms var(--ease-out) {menuD}, transform 320ms var(--spring-soft) {menuD}`. menuD is '560ms' while hovered (so it enters after typing) and '0ms' when not hovered (so it exits at once). Under reduced motion the menu transform stays at translateY(0).

EXPAND (card → full screen) sequence in expand(el, url):
- t0: set the overlay to {x,y,w,h} = the card's layout rect in stage coordinates, r = '6px', o = 0, tr = 'none'.
- Next double rAF: o = 1 with tr = 'opacity 140ms var(--ease-out)'.
- +120ms after that: set {x:0, y:0, w:1920, h:1080, r:'0px', o:1} with tr = 'left 420ms var(--spring-soft), top 420ms var(--spring-soft), width 420ms var(--spring-soft), height 420ms var(--spring-soft), border-radius 420ms var(--spring-soft)'.
- +520ms after the rAF: window.location.href = url.
- The overlay is flat var(--paper) with an inset 1px hairline, z-index 20, and covers everything including the header.

REDUCED MOTION.
- The CSS var --spring-soft becomes steps(1, jump-start), so every spring transition jumps instantly.
- JS reduced() makes arrival transforms 'none', skips the hover lift, keeps the menu transform at 0, and skips the expand overlay (navigates immediately).
- Opacity fades with ease-out and the steps(9) typewriter STILL animate under reduced motion.
- The tw expression reduces to (ht ? '9ch' : '0ch') in both modes.
No keyframe animations (@keyframes) exist in this file. All motion is CSS transitions driven by state changes.
algorithms: STAGE FIT: sc = Math.min(vw/1920, vh/1080); x = Math.round((vw - 1920*sc)/2); y = Math.round((vh - 1080*sc)/2). The stage is transform: scale(sc) with origin 0 0 at left x, top y.

TIME OF DAY: hour = new Date().getHours(). The word is 'morning' if hour < 12, 'afternoon' if hour < 18, otherwise 'evening'. headline = 'Where to this ' + word + '?'. greeting = ('Good morning' | 'Good afternoon' | 'Good evening') + ' · Monday 5 October'. The date part is hard-coded.
ARRIVAL HELPER: arr(on) = { o: on ? 1 : 0, t: (on || reduced) ? 'none' : 'translateY(10px)' }. a0 through a5 are all arr(arrived). a3 is computed but unused.
HOVER LIFT: lift(on) = (on && !reduced) ? 'translateY(-4px)' : 'none'. Card transform = arrived ? lift(hovered) : (reduced ? 'none' : 'translateY(14px)').
PERCENT FORMAT: pct(v) = (v*100).toFixed(2) + '%'. For example 0.575 gives '57.50%'.

CAPACITY STRIP.
- CAP = [8, 8, 7, 7, 7, 8, 7, 7, 7, 9.5, 7, 7, 8, 7, 6.5, 7, 7, 6, 5.5, 6, 5.5, 5.5, 3, 3, 3, 8, 7, 7, 7, 7] (30 values, hours per period on an 8h day).
- CAPH = the same except indices 16, 17 and 18 are 9, 9, 9 instead of 7, 6, 5.5 (the hover 'what-if').
- Use CAPH when hovering the Control Panel card, otherwise CAP.
- For each h at index i: over = h > 8; height = arrived ? (h/10*100)+'%' : '0%', so the bar scale tops out at 10h = 100% of the 44px strip; delay = i*12 + 'ms'.
- bg = over ? 'color-mix(in oklch, var(--overload) 22%, var(--paper))' : (i >= 25 ? 'var(--fi-accent-soft)' : 'var(--pc-accent-soft)').
- line = over ? 'var(--overload)' : (i >= 25 ? 'var(--fi-accent)' : 'var(--pc-accent)').
- Meaning: indices 0-24 are Private Credit, 25-29 are Fixed Income after the move. Index 9 (9.5h) is the one standing overload, which echoes the seed's 'Wed 4 Nov (BD3) 9.5h of an 8h day'. Indices 22-24 (3h) look like a holiday or low-capacity dip (Christmas). Note that bar 25 starts at 83.3% of the width, while the move line is drawn at 84%.

MINI GANTT ROWS.
- col = { pc: 'var(--pc-accent)', fi: 'var(--fi-accent)' }; hc = (hover === 'cp').
- rowsDef:
  - [0] { d:'pc', x:0.02, end: hc ? 0.655 : 0.62, tgt:0.575, ms:[0.2,0.36,0.5], ghost: hc ? 0.62 : 0.575 }
  - [1] { d:'pc', x:0.08, end:0.68, ms:[0.2,0.42] }
  - [2] { d:'pc', x:0.1, end:0.74, ms:[0.38,0.55,0.62] }
  - [3] { d:'fi', x:0.06, end:0.84, ms:[0.3,0.52,0.76] }
  - [4] { d:'fi', x:0.62, end:1.02, hatch:true }
- For each row i:
  - w = arrived ? Math.min(r.tgt || r.end, r.end) - r.x : 0
  - risk = r.tgt && r.end > r.tgt
  - y = 86 + i*34 (px); accent = col[d]; delay d = (i*50 + 80) + 'ms'
  - x = pct(r.x); w = pct(Math.max(0, w))
  - bg = hatch ? 'repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, ' + (pc ? 'var(--pc-accent-soft)' : 'var(--fi-accent-soft)') + ' 0 4px, transparent 4px 8px)' : accent
  - line = hatch ? accent : 'transparent'
  - ox = pct(r.tgt || r.end); ow = pct(arrived && risk ? r.end - r.tgt : 0)
  - gx = pct(r.x); gw = pct(r.ghost ? r.ghost - r.x : 0); go = r.ghost ? (hc ? 0.9 : 0.4) : 0
  - ms = r.ms.map(pct) (default []); ds = arrived ? 1 : 0
- Resolved values at rest:
  - Row 0 bar 2%→57.5% (w 55.50%), overrun 57.50% w 4.50%, ghost w 55.50% at opacity 0.4. On hover: overrun w 8.00%, ghost w 60.00% at opacity 0.9.
  - Row 1 8%→68% (w 60%).
  - Row 2 10%→74% (w 64%).
  - Row 3 6%→84% (w 78%, ends exactly at the move line).
  - Row 4 62%→102% (w 40%, hatched, overflows 2% past the right edge into the card padding).
- Semantics: row 0 = the Returns pipeline forecast landing past its target (amber overrun); the hatch = FI work with no plan yet; the 4% line = today; the 84% line = the move to FI.

TEXTBOOK COUNT LINE.
- Parse remi.textbook.v1 and set pgs = tbk && tbk.pages ? tbk.pages : null.
- ch = pgs ? sum over pages of p.blocks.filter(b => b.type === 'chart' && (b.html || b.src)).length : 1.
- tbPages = (pgs ? pgs.length : 4) + ' pages · ' + ch + ' live chart' + (ch === 1 ? '' : 's').
- 'pages' is never singularised.
CONTROL PANEL META LINE: s.projects + ' projects · ' + s.routines + ' routines · ' + s.notes + ' note' + (s.notes === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' today'. 'projects' and 'routines' are never singularised.
SLASH MENU ITEMS: [['Heading', true], ['Formula', false], ['Callout', false], ['Link to project', false]] mapped to { l, bg: on ? 'color-mix(in oklch, var(--ink) 6%, transparent)' : 'transparent' }.

EXPAND GEOMETRY: x = el.offsetLeft + el.offsetParent.offsetLeft; y = el.offsetTop + el.offsetParent.offsetTop. offsetParent is the absolutely positioned grid (left 120, top 388), so the Control Panel card gives (120, 388, 816x560) and the Textbook card gives (984, 388, 816x560). These are unscaled layout pixels, which is correct because the overlay sits inside the scaled stage. offset* ignores the -4px hover transform, so the overlay starts 4px below the lifted card.
TYPEWRITER: typeW = hover === 'tb' ? '9ch' : '0ch', animated with steps(9, end). 'Convexity' has 9 characters.
backendImplications: Add a Home summary endpoint, e.g. GET /api/home/summary. It should return: today (ISO date plus the display strings 'Mon 5 Oct' and 'Monday 5 October'); businessDayOfMonth (the 'BD3' label, from the holiday calendar); businessDaysToMove (61, computed between today and the move date 2027-01-04 using the business-day calendar); projectCount; routineCount; notesTodayCount (notes whose date equals today, not a hard-coded '2026-10-05'); and the flagship project's forecast plus delta vs target in BD (Returns pipeline: forecast 2026-12-02 vs target 2026-11-27 = +3 BD). These need the core calendar/business-day utilities in the backend (utils/ or core/) and the project forecast service.

Add Textbook stats to the same summary or a separate GET /api/textbook/stats: pageCount and liveChartCount (chart blocks with an uploaded html or src). Once textbook pages and blocks live in the DB, this is a simple COUNT query in a repository.

Optional, for a data-driven Control Panel preview (currently decorative and hard-coded):
- A capacity series of about 30 periods, with hours per period, capacity (8h) and a domain split (PC before the move, FI after). It would come from the same dayLoad computation the Timeline uses.
- A compact Gantt of up to 5 projects: {domain, startPct, targetPct, forecastPct, milestonePcts[], hasPlan}, normalised to a window where today ≈ 4% and the move ≈ 84%.
If the preview is made real, the hover 'what-if' state (+2 BD slip, 3 overload days) either needs a what-if/scenario endpoint or stays purely illustrative. Product decision needed.

No writes happen on this page. Navigation targets become client routes: /control-panel (Remi.dc.html) and /textbook (Remi Textbook.dc.html). The localStorage reads ('remi.v1', 'remi.textbook.v1') are replaced by the API calls above, and a migration/import endpoint could ingest existing localStorage blobs from the prototype.
The 'A personal instrument. Nothing here is shared.' promise implies a single-user, local or private deployment. Auth should be scoped to one user, and no sharing features.
risksAndQuirks: Hard-coded 'today': the header says 'Mon 5 Oct · BD3' and '61 business days to Fixed Income', and the greeting says 'Monday 5 October'. The notes lookup uses the fixed key '2026-10-05'. Meanwhile the greeting's time-of-day word uses the real clock, so the page can say 'Good evening' next to a hard-coded date. All of these must come from the real date plus the calendar service.
Returns pipeline forecast 'Wed 2 Dec', delta '+3 BD', and the hover values 'Fri 4 Dec' / '+5 BD' are hard-coded strings.
The CAP and CAPH arrays and rowsDef geometry are hard-coded illustrations, not derived from data. CAPH differs from CAP only at indices 16-18 (9, 9, 9 vs 7, 6, 5.5).
Fallback bug: `(s.projects || []).length || 5` and `(s.routines || []).length || 2` show 5 and 2 when the user genuinely has 0 projects or routines.
When 'remi.v1' is absent, notes is forced to 3 to mirror the seed data. When it is present but has no notes for '2026-10-05', notes is 0.
Pluralisation: 'pages', 'projects' and 'routines' are always plural ('1 pages', '1 projects'). Only 'note(s)' and 'live chart(s)' are pluralised correctly.
The textbook count reads p.blocks without a guard. A page without blocks throws, the error is silently caught, and the label stays at the default '4 pages · 1 live chart'.
tbPages is first set synchronously to '4 pages · 1 live chart' and then overwritten from storage, both inside componentDidMount.

Keyboard shortcuts '1' and '2' are global. They have no modifier or focus guards, so they would fire while typing if an input is ever added. They also fire on numpad keys. There is no Escape, and nothing cancels an expansion in progress. Production should scope them and ignore events from editable targets and events with modifiers.

Accessibility gaps:
- The cards are clickable divs with no role=link or button, no tabindex, no focus ring and no aria-label.
- The arrow 'button' is decorative.
- The Material Symbols glyph is ligature text ('arrow_forward') with no aria-hidden.
- The Roll component does set aria-hidden on its animated layer and keeps a hidden real-text layer.
The expand overlay reads offsetTop, which ignores the hover lift transform, so the overlay starts 4px below the visually lifted card and makes a small jump.

Navigation is a full page load (window.location.href) to sibling .dc.html files. The overlay is a fake shared-element transition, and the destination pages have no matching fade-in. In a production SPA, use router navigation with a real shared-layout transition (e.g. the View Transitions API or Framer Motion layoutId), and consider a fade-in on the destination.
Timers t1 and t2 are cleared on unmount, but the outer double rAF is not cancelled.
Under reduced motion, opacity transitions and the steps(9) typewriter still animate. Only spring-based motion and translations are disabled.

The icon font URL requests icon_names=arrow_forward,north_east, but north_east is unused. The global `a` and `a:hover` styles are unused. State `soon` and render value `a3` are unused. These are leftovers from earlier iterations.

The screenshots in screenshots/01-home.png, 02-home.png and 03-home.png show an OLDER iteration that differs from the current code:
- a sub-headline paragraph ('Plan the move to Fixed Income in the Control Panel, or write things down properly in the Textbook.')
- an 'IN THE WORKS' badge on Textbook
- a different Textbook description ('Notes you can build a career on: numbered sections, clean formulas, linked to your work.')
- an 'FI move' label on the move line
- the slash menu shown below the Convexity line
- a footer reading 'Press 1 for the Control Panel'
The code in the .dc.html is the source of truth.
The 30 capacity bars are split at index 25 (83.33%), but the move line is at 84%. They do not line up exactly.
Row 4 (hatched FI) extends to 102%, past the preview's right edge into the card padding. This is deliberate, to suggest it runs beyond the window.
The ghost outline's width change on hover is not transitioned; only its opacity is.

Colours use OKLCH and color-mix(in oklch, …), and the easing uses CSS linear() spring curves. These need modern browsers (Safari 17.2+ / Chrome 113+ for linear()). Keep them as CSS variables in production.

Fonts load from the Google Fonts CDN: Albert Sans (wght 300..700, italic 400..600), JetBrains Mono (400, 500), Libre Caslon Text (400, 700, italic 400), and Material Symbols Outlined. For an offline or compliance-sensitive deployment, self-host them. The brand fonts and colours are placeholders pending Ninety One brand values.
localState: vw, vh (numbers): the viewport size. Initialised from window.innerWidth/innerHeight (fallback 1920x1080) and updated on resize. Drives the stage scale and offsets.

arrived (bool, initially false): set true after a double requestAnimationFrame on mount. Drives every entrance transition (opacity, translateY, capacity bar heights, Gantt widths, overrun widths, diamond scale).

hover (null | 'cp' | 'tb'): set by the cards' onMouseEnter and cleared by onMouseLeave. Drives the card lift, border, arrow button fill, the CAP/CAPH switch, row-0 end/ghost, Roll values, the typewriter, caret, 1.2 opacity and the slash menu.
ex (null | {x, y, w, h, r, o, tr}): expand-overlay geometry and transition. While non-null it blocks further expand() calls.
notes (number, default 0; 3 if remi.v1 is absent): notes today, shown in the Control Panel meta line.
projects (number, default 5): project count for the Control Panel meta line.
routines (number, default 2): routine count for the Control Panel meta line.
tbPages (string, set on mount, default '4 pages · 1 live chart'): the Textbook footer label.
Instance fields: cpRef and tbRef (React refs to the card DOM nodes), onResize and onKey (listeners), t1 and t2 (timeouts for the expand phase and navigation).
actionsInvoked: No shared `model` actions: Home is a standalone page and does not receive the Remi.dc.html model.
openCP(): expand(cpRef.current, 'Remi.dc.html'). Runs the overlay animation and then navigates to the Control Panel.
openTB(): expand(tbRef.current, 'Remi%20Textbook.dc.html'). Runs the overlay animation and then navigates to the Textbook.
expand(el, url): sets the ex overlay state in 3 phases, then sets window.location.href = url at +520ms. Under reduced motion or with no element it navigates immediately.
setState({hover}): from card enter and leave.
localStorage.getItem('remi.v1') and localStorage.getItem('remi.textbook.v1'): read-only. Home never writes storage.

./support.js: the dc runtime (React-like DCLogic, sc-for, dc-import).
Child component: Roll.dc.html, via <dc-import name="Roll" value=...>, used twice.
No AI calls (window.claude), no fetches, no iframes on this page.
Navigation targets: 'Remi.dc.html' and 'Remi%20Textbook.dc.html'. Inbound links come from the Remi.dc.html and Remi Textbook.dc.html goHome actions, which go to 'Remi%20Home.dc.html'.
persistence: Reads 'remi.v1' once on mount (JSON.parse, try/catch). It uses notes['2026-10-05'].length, projects.length and routines.length. The owner and writer is Remi.dc.html, which saves {projects, tasks, feed, funds, routines, doneOn, bauDone, notes, ...} with a debounced setItem.

Reads 'remi.textbook.v1' once on mount (JSON.parse, try/catch). It uses pages.length and the count of chart blocks with html or src. The owner and writer is Remi Textbook.dc.html, which saves {cur, sections, pages:[{id, section, title, updated, blocks:[...]}]}. Chart blocks can embed the full chart HTML, so this blob can be large.

Home writes nothing to storage. There is no migration logic here. Values are not re-read on focus or visibility changes; they only refresh on page reload, which always happens because navigation is a full page load.
